recipes.name: Quick Angel Hair with Basil Cream for One
ingredients_raw: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the angel hair pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Once done, set aside 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain the pasta in a colander in the sink. Keep warm.

While the pasta is cooking, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the onion, and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the garlic, and continue cooking until the onion has softened and turned translucent, 1 to 2 minutes more.

Pour in the heavy cream, and stir in the Parmesan cheese, basil, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 2 minutes. Dilute with the reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick for your taste. Pour the sauce over the angel hair pasta to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Quick Angel Hair with Basil Cream for One
raw_recipe.description: Creamy basil, garlic and butter sauce over angel hair pasta. What could be better?

review.reviewBody: This dish was AWESOME! It seriously tasted like something from Olive Garden. The only thing I did different was that I added a small handful of mozzerella cheese to the sauce and I didnt use any of the pasta water. I also sauted some shrimp in butter and a clove of minced garlic and it turned out perfect! I will be making this one again and again!

I made this as is stated but sauted the onions with salt and pepper, added one whole fresh red hot chile pepper as well for flavor. Next the garlic 2 cloves, cooked a minute then the milk (1/2 & half )and parmesan cheese, some fresh bacon bits a quick stir, then added the cooked pasta and fresh basil leaves and finally the hot salted cooking water, stirred and DEVOURED...so GOOD! ** I used 3 oz spaghetti, this made 2 lunch portions nicely.

Fantastic! I added in mushrooms & spinach in the sauce. I also served a blackened salmon filet on top. The pasta is delicious on its own I just added the fish for extra protien. The key to this delicious pasta is to season The garlic and onion mixture right before you add in the whipping cream. I am very very pleased with the results. For color to the plate I added a few dice tomatoes on top to garnish. ***angel hair pasta cooks really fast so watch it carefully... you might want to cook it once your sauce is almost done. I omitted the part that said use pasta water in the sauce. Its unnecessary

I have made this so many times, my husband and I love it! I've done it several ways, but here's my favorite. I add a ton of chopped mushrooms with the onion ( I put mushrooms in everything) I also add 2 TBSP of flour to the butter mixture to thicken it a little. I use Fat Free Half and Half (that's why it needs thickened a little). Much healthier and I don't miss the cream! Also put in a pinch of nutmeg and 1/2 cup of shredded mozzerella. Delicious!!

Fantastic!!! After reading everyone's issues with thickness, and especially since I am a carbonara expert (Thanks Dad!), the best way to get desired thickness is a low flame for 20-30 minutes, constant stirring, and if necessary, 2 tbsp of cornstarch and 2 tbsp of cold water mixture. Other than the usual additions of shrimp, chicken or veggies, I wouldn't have changed a thing!!

The recipe turned out great, I added one more clove of garlic and some white wine to the sauce, basically I made enough for 2 people so I bumped up all the ingredients just a tad and added a leftover cooked chicken breast. I would make this again, Thanks for the recipe, SharFras

I had about 2 tbs of pesto I needed to use so I incorporated it along with some freshly chopped basil. I used 1/2 & 1/2 and just let it cook over a low flame until the right consistency. There is no way I felt as if I was stuck eating leftovers, this was restaurant quality!

WOW! My family really loved this. I needed this for 6 and it converted very easily. I wanted to add chicken so I just cut chicken breasts into bite size pieces seasoned with salt and peper and cooked them with the onions and garlic. I also had some really fresh tomatoes so I chopped them into small pieces and added them to the top of the dish after it was on the plate. This made a wonderful addition. I will be making this a lot.

I thought this was good but not spectacular. It was a little bland to me and tasted a little too much of parmesan. If I make this again I will whisk in an egg yolk like I do for Alfredo, add some tarragon, and more butter for sure. I'll saute some mushrooms in the butter with the onions first, before adding the garlic. It's a decent recipe but needs tweaking to suit me. My boyfriend liked it just fine so I gave it 4 stars.

This was wonderful! A perfect sauce. I did make a few revisions - I used 1/2 cup of whipping cream and 1/2 cup of milk - I don't like pasta that is too rich...I also added some chopped mushrooms, fresh diced tomatoes as a topping and I added a pinch of nutmeg to the sauce. The taste was wonderful and my husband was licking the plate! Thanks for this wonderful recipe!

Absolutely delicious & so simple to make! I actually switched it a little - instead of basil I made it with fresh parsley. & used Mafalda pasta tossed in some fresh green beans & cauliflower to add some veggies to the mix. It's incredible.
This is decadant. I made 2 changes - I used 1 Tablespoon of butter instead of 2 and while cooking the onion and garlic I sauted 4 prawns. It was fast to prepare and soooo good.
I have not yet tried this home made recipe but I will soon and I'm a big fan of past Alfredo angle hair dishes but like I said I have not tried this yet but I will soon as I can.

This is one of those recipes where you can't help but think, why didn't I try to do something like this before. Excellent flavor. I don't use cream often so I actually used 2% milk as a substitute, and it still turned out great. I love when I can find a recipe that both hubby and I agree on the first time tried.
Fantastic! I replaced clove of minced garlic with just garlic salt and it was still delicious! Next time I'm gonna buy garlic clove and see if it can get even better.
used fat free 1/2 and 1/2. Came out very runny even though cooked it awhile. Did thicken up as cooled. Worth trying again- company really liked it.
This is as good as anything you'll have in a restaurant, and presents very nicely. Add a spinach salad a Black Angus Garlic Bread...lovely!

Made the recipe as is except for some minor changes. I used half-and-half instead of heavy cream and added about 1 T flour to the sauce before adding the cream to make a thicker sauce. Neither of these changes changed the integrity of the recipe. I think this is a good quick lunch especially during a pasta craving but nothing particularly special. It does taste like some box mixes I have tried. I may make it again but will probably tweak it extensively.
This was delicious! Will definately make again.

This was awesome!!! This is the first time I have ever been moved to actually write a review and I have been using this site for years! BTW I did not have fresh basil and used dried; I also added a little parsley as well. I upped the servings to 4 but only used 1 carton of heavy cream (2 cups) and the consistency was still perfect.
